source.title: ProfitProphet v2.10.3 release / v2.10.2 source-rate rebuild (Aug 2026)
source.author: CaducaeCo

quote: Prospecting values for 21 ores and milling values for 23 herbs have been rebuilt from independently sourced drop rates
notes: New candidate SOURCE-ORIGIN lead, NOT a completed-cast study. In the v2.10.2 dated Aug 25 release notes embedded in the Aug 26 v2.10.3 file page, author says 21 ores and 23 herbs have externally sourced rates cross-checked against measured samples. Coverage counts 21/23 are counts of table categories, NOT casts, item quantities, hit rates or confidence. No cited original sample URLs, at-cast event records, precise input itemIDs or ranks, zero-inclusive histograms, refunds, player skill/spec or proof any of the 21 ores includes Midnight Umbral Tin 237362 / Refulgent Copper 237359 / Brilliant Silver 237365 or the 23 herbs includes Tranquility Bloom 236761. Do not import the modeled rates or use ProfitProphet's computed gold EV as data; follow up source provenance and request permission for raw underlying anonymized samples. Important cross-expansion caution: release labels multiple game flavors and retail 12.0.7, not proof that its tables are current Retail 12.1.5.
lookingFor: Public original source-attributed raw Midnight Prospecting and Milling operation data behind ProfitProphet's Aug 2026 21-ore/23-herb table rebuild, especially Umbral Tin Ore, Refulgent Copper Ore, Brilliant Silver Ore and Tranquility Bloom; also a firsthand Miststalker's Wristbands actual disenchant itemLink/context
